prompt_md: A tennis game is at deuce: whoever first gets two points ahead wins. The server wins each point with chance 60%, independently. What's her chance of winning the game?
prompt_short: Tennis from deuce, 60% per point. Server's chance to win?
hint_md: Look at points in pairs: a split pair sends you back to deuce.
explain_intuition_md: A 60% player feels like a 60% winner. But each pair of points either settles the game or resets it to deuce. She takes both points 36% of the time and loses both 16% of the time, so she wins 36 out of every 52 deciding pairs.
